PerilStep.titre: What condition is the monument in?
PerilStep.pourquoi: At risk or in poor overall condition: weakened structure, not watertight, partial collapse, worsening damage. Several emergency schemes are reserved for these situations.

indices.bon: The monument is broadly sound, even if it needs routine maintenance work.
indices.moyen: There is some damage, but it threatens neither the structure nor the building envelope.
indices.mauvais: Significant damage affects the structure or the building envelope.
indices.peril: Weakened structure, not watertight, partial collapse, worsening damage.

ProjectIntentStep.titre: What do you want to do?
ProjectIntentStep.consigne: One answer only: this is the purpose of this project.
ProjectIntentStep.pourquoi: We will then only ask you the questions relevant to this purpose. A different purpose means a separate project on the same monument.

ProjectTravauxStep.titre: What will the planned works cover?
ProjectTravauxStep.pourquoi: Some schemes only fund one specific type of structure.
ProjectTravauxStep.indiceSuivant: Tick at least one type of works, or “Not decided yet”.

ProjectFamillesStep.titre: What do you want to bring to life?
ProjectFamillesStep.pourquoi: Schemes do not all fund the same activities, and we will only ask you the questions for the ones you tick.
ProjectFamillesStep.indiceSuivant: Tick at least one activity, or “I don’t know yet”.
ProjectFamillesStep.travauxIndice: Fitting out, bringing up to standard, restoration: we will ask you what they cover.
ProjectFamillesStep.toutMontrer: I don’t know yet, show me everything
ProjectFamillesStep.toutMontrerIndice: We will show you every scheme within reach of the monument, without filtering by activity.
